hints.title: Target Bit Population
hints.text: Count the number of set bits k in num2. The result x must contain exactly k set bits.

hints.title: High Bit Cancellation
hints.text: To minimize x xor num1, greedily set the same most-significant bits where num1 has 1s.

hints.title: Low Bit Allocation
hints.text: If k set bits remain after matching all 1-bits of num1, set the lowest available 0-bits of num1 to keep the value minimal.

hints.title: Greedy Bit Alignment Implementation

complexity.notes: Two fixed 32-bit iterations to place high and low set bits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching all positive integers x checking bit counts is unbounded.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory operates directly on 32-bit integer representations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prioritizes matching high 1-bits first, filling remaining budget from lowest 0-bits.
